+# Phase 2 and 3 Results
+
+## Scope and RTL status
+
+The DUT copy in this phase was not modified. The Phase 0/1 source and
+configurations were not edited. Mutations were run in isolated copies under
+`mutants/`.
+
+## Toolchain
+
+| Tool | Version |
+|---|---|
+| Yosys | 0.69+20 (git sha1 3a8289484) |
+| SymbiYosys | 0.69 |
+| Z3 | 4.13.3, 64-bit |
+| Python | 3.14.4 |
+| matplotlib | 3.11.2 |
+
+## Phase 1 clock-model evidence and rerun
+
+The default generated preparation scripts in `formal/async_fifo_{bmc,prove,cover}/model/design_prep.ys`
+contain `async2sync` and `formalff -setundef -clk2ff`. They do not contain
+`clk2fflogic`. This is a converted, single-global-step model, not evidence of
+independent-clock CDC behavior. The multiclock SBY configuration enables
+`multiclock on`.
+
+| Command | Result |
+|---|---|
+| `sby -f async_fifo_multiclock.sby bmc` | FAIL at `async_fifo_formal.sv:131`, step 9 |
+| `sby -f async_fifo_multiclock.sby prove` | FAIL in base case at the same assertion |
+| `sby -f async_fifo_multiclock.sby cover` | PASS; all three Phase 1 cover statements reached |
+
+The BMC trace is a checker/model failure rather than a confirmed RTL defect:
+with independent clocks, the Phase 1 read-empty formula assertion compares
+state from independently reset/synchronized domains without an established
+cross-domain relation. No Phase 1 property or source was changed.
+
+## Phase 2 properties and assumptions
+
+The harness checks:
+
+* **P2a:** accepted writes cannot exceed scoreboard capacity.
+* **P2b:** accepted reads cannot occur with an empty scoreboard.
+* **P2c:** the tagged sequence item is written before it is read and its data
+  matches at read time.
+* **P2d:** `wr_full_next` equals the intended Gray-pointer full comparison.
+* Helper assertions relate the scoreboard counters to DUT binary pointers,
+  binary and Gray pointers, occupancy, and the tagged item’s in-flight memory
+  location.
+
+There are no `assume` statements. The harness structurally holds reset low
+until each clock has had an edge, and makes reset permanently high thereafter.
+Both clocks and all transaction inputs/data remain unconstrained. As with the
+rest of this formal abstraction, reset recovery/removal timing is not modeled.
+
+The tagged sequence index is frozen from a free input and spans two pointer
+laps; the finite scoreboard counters wrap at `2**(ADDR_WIDTH+1)`.
+
+| Command/configuration | Result | Notes |
+|---|---|---|
+| `sby -f async_fifo_integrity.sby cover` (ADDR_WIDTH=4, depth 44) | PASS, 52 s | All three covers reached: tagged check (step 10), second-lap tag check (step 42), and both counters beyond the first lap (step 42). |
+| `sby -f async_fifo_integrity.sby bmc` (ADDR_WIDTH=4, depth 44) | TIMEOUT, 1800 s | The completed sweep run hit its timeout. A prior preserved attempt had reached step 25 without a result. |
+| `sby -f async_fifo_integrity.sby prove` (ADDR_WIDTH=4, depth 44) | TIMEOUT, 1800 s | The completed sweep run hit its timeout; no unbounded proof result. |
+| Width-2, depth-20 integrity BMC | PASS, 128 s | Bounded to 20 global steps; not an unbounded proof. |
+| Width-2, depth-20 integrity prove | UNKNOWN, 122 s | Base case passed; temporal induction failed on helper and tagged-item assertions. This is an unreachable-state induction failure, not a reachable counterexample. |
+| Width-2 cover, depth 20 | FAIL | Tagged check and first-lap cover reached, but second-lap tagged cover was beyond this bound. |
+| Width-2 cover, depth 32 | PASS, 11 s | Reached the second-lap tagged cover at step 24. |
+| Width-4 integrity cover, depth 44 | PASS, 52 s | Tagged check at step 10; second-lap tag check and both counters beyond the first lap at step 42. |
+
+The hierarchical reference to `dut.u_mem.mem[...]` elaborates successfully.
+The additional in-flight assertions are themselves asserted (never assumed),
+but the current induction run still cannot establish them from arbitrary
+induction states. The Phase 2 safety properties are therefore **not proven
+unbounded**.
+
+## Mutation tests
+
+All mutations were applied only to copies under `mutants/`.
+
+| Mutation | Result | Property that caught it |
+|---|---|---|
+| Remove `~wr_full` from write-pointer increment | FAIL | P2a no-overflow |
+| Remove `~rd_empty` from read-pointer increment | FAIL | P2b no-underflow; tagged integrity also fails |
+| Write memory at address +1 | FAIL | P2c tagged-data equality |
+| Wrong bit in `wr_full_next` Gray comparison | FAIL at step 9 | P2d full-comparison helper assertion |
+
+All four specified mutations were detected. The wrong-full-comparison mutant
+was not caught by the initial integrity assertions; adding P2d made the
+mutation fail. The unmodified width-2 control passed the 16-step BMC both
+before and after adding P2d.
+
+Reproduction commands (run from `phase 2 and 3/`):
+
+```sh
+(cd mutants/wr_full_gate && sby -f quick.sby bmc)
+(cd mutants/rd_empty_gate && sby -f quick.sby bmc)
+(cd mutants/write_addr && sby -f quick.sby bmc)
+(cd mutants/full_compare && sby -f flagcheck.sby bmc)
+```
+
+## Phase 3 sweep
+
+The command `./sweep.sh` was run with defaults (`ADDRS="2 3 4 5"`,
+`DATA_W=8`, `TIMEOUT=1800`, tasks `bmc prove cover`, and both SBY files).
+The full 24-run result set is in [`sweep_results.csv`](../sweep_results.csv);
+the plotted output is [`runtime_vs_depth.png`](../runtime_vs_depth.png).
+
+The original sweep depth formula is
+`2**(ADDR_WIDTH+1) + 12`. At width 2 this bound is insufficient for the
+second-lap tagged cover; the standalone width-2 cover passed at depth 32.
+Interpret width-2 cover status accordingly. The width-2 sweep also confirms
+the multiclock Phase 1 BMC/prove failures repeat at reduced depth, while its
+Phase 1 covers pass.
+

+
+The runtime increase is already pronounced from 4 entries to 8 entries: the
+bounded integrity run grew from 128 s to 1467 s. At 16 entries, both BMC and
+prove hit the 1800 s limit; the 32-entry BMC and prove also timed out. Covers
+remain reachable but take 663 s at 32 entries. Thus no depth-32 proof passed.
+
+## Reproduction commands
+
+Run from `phase 2 and 3/`:
+
+```sh
+sby -f async_fifo_integrity.sby bmc
+sby -f async_fifo_integrity.sby cover
+sby -f async_fifo_integrity.sby prove
+sby -f async_fifo_multiclock.sby
+./sweep.sh
+python3 plot_sweep.py
+```
+
+The sweep makes per-width copies under `sweep_work/`, so parameter substitutions
+do not modify the source RTL or original SBY files. For the width-2 second-lap
+cover control, use a copy of the integrity SBY config with `depth 32`.
+
+## What remains unproven
+
+* The width-4 full-depth integrity BMC and prove tasks did not finish within
+  the 30-minute budget.
+* The induction failure is not a reachable counterexample and does not prove
+  the properties false; it means the present invariants are insufficient for
+  this engine/model to establish the safety claims.
+* Phase 1 multiclock safety assertion at line 131 remains an independent
+  checker/model concern and was not changed under the Phase 0/1 freeze.

+// async_fifo_integrity_top.sv
+// Phase 2: data-integrity proof for the Gray-code async FIFO.
+//
+// Formal top level. Wraps the unmodified async_fifo, drives it with free
+// inputs, and checks it with a "tagged item" scoreboard.
+//
+// HOW THE CHECK WORKS
+//   The solver picks ONE sequence number (tag_seq) and holds it fixed. The
+//   checker counts accepted writes (wr_cnt) and accepted reads (rd_cnt)
+//   independently of the DUT's own pointers. When write number tag_seq
+//   happens, its data is captured. When read number tag_seq happens, the
+//   data coming out of the FIFO must equal what was captured. Because
+//   tag_seq can be any value, this covers every position in the stream:
+//   a dropped, duplicated, reordered, overwritten or stale item shifts the
+//   numbering and produces a mismatch.
+//
+//   tag_seq has ADDR_WIDTH+1 bits, so it spans two full laps of the memory
+//   (every slot is exercised twice, and every pointer wrap state is hit).
+//   Items beyond 2**(ADDR_WIDTH+1) alias onto the same tag values and are
+//   not individually tracked. State that limit in the paper.
+//
+// ENVIRONMENT ASSUMPTIONS (built structurally, no assume statements)
+//   1. wr_clk and rd_clk are free: any ratio, any phase (needs the
+//      `multiclock on` option in the .sby file).
+//   2. One shared reset, held low until BOTH clocks have ticked at least
+//      once, then released and never asserted again.
+//   3. Reset release timing relative to the clocks is not modeled
+//      (recovery/removal is a physical-design concern).
+//   4. wr_en, wr_data, rd_en are completely free every step.
+//
+// PROPERTIES
+//   P2a  no overflow : an accepted write never happens when the FIFO holds
+//                      DEPTH items
+//   P2b  no underflow: an accepted read never happens when it holds 0 items
+//   P2c  integrity   : the tag_seq-th item read equals the tag_seq-th item
+//                      written (covers ordering, loss, duplication,
+//                      overwrite)
+//   P2d  full flag   : wr_full_next matches the Gray-pointer comparison
+//   Covers prove the tagged check actually fires, on the second lap too.
+
+module async_fifo_integrity_top #(
+    parameter DATA_WIDTH = 8,
+    parameter ADDR_WIDTH = 4
+) (
+    input logic                  wr_clk,
+    input logic                  rd_clk,
+    input logic                  wr_en,
+    input logic [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] wr_data,
+    input logic                  rd_en,
+    input logic [ADDR_WIDTH:0]   tag_seq_in   // free; sampled once, then frozen
+);
+
+  localparam SEQ_W = ADDR_WIDTH + 1;
+  localparam int DEPTH = 1 << ADDR_WIDTH;
+
+  // ------------------------------------------------------------------
+  // Structural reset: low until both clocks have ticked once, then high
+  // forever. Each domain therefore sees at least one edge while in reset.
+  // ------------------------------------------------------------------
+  logic wr_seen;
+  logic rd_seen;
+  logic wr_reset_done;
+  logic rd_reset_done;
+  logic rst_n;
+  initial begin
+    wr_seen = 1'b0;
+    rd_seen = 1'b0;
+    wr_reset_done = 1'b0;
+    rd_reset_done = 1'b0;
+  end
+  always_ff @(posedge wr_clk) begin
+    wr_seen <= 1'b1;
+    if (!rst_n)
+      wr_reset_done <= 1'b1;
+    if (wr_seen)
+      assert (wr_reset_done);
+  end
+  always_ff @(posedge rd_clk) begin
+    rd_seen <= 1'b1;
+    if (!rst_n)
+      rd_reset_done <= 1'b1;
+    if (rd_seen)
+      assert (rd_reset_done);
+  end
+
+  assign rst_n = wr_seen & rd_seen;
+
+  // ------------------------------------------------------------------
+  // Frozen tag index: take a free input at the first write-clock edge,
+  // then never change it. Behaves like an "any constant" without needing
+  // a frontend-specific attribute.
+  // ------------------------------------------------------------------
+  logic             tag_set;
+  logic [SEQ_W-1:0] tag_seq;
+  initial tag_set = 1'b0;
+  always_ff @(posedge wr_clk) begin
+    if (!tag_set) begin
+      tag_seq <= tag_seq_in;
+      tag_set <= 1'b1;
+    end
+  end
+
+  // ------------------------------------------------------------------
+  // Device under test (unmodified)
+  // ------------------------------------------------------------------
+  logic                  wr_full;
+  logic                  rd_empty;
+  logic [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] rd_data;
+
+  async_fifo #(
+      .DATA_WIDTH(DATA_WIDTH),
+      .ADDR_WIDTH(ADDR_WIDTH)
+  ) dut (
+      .wr_clk  (wr_clk),
+      .wr_rst_n(rst_n),
+      .wr_en   (wr_en),
+      .wr_data (wr_data),
+      .wr_full (wr_full),
+      .rd_clk  (rd_clk),
+      .rd_rst_n(rst_n),
+      .rd_en   (rd_en),
+      .rd_data (rd_data),
+      .rd_empty(rd_empty)
+  );
+
+  // Accepted operations, as seen at the clock edge (pre-edge flag values)
+  logic wr_acc;
+  logic rd_acc;
+  assign wr_acc = wr_en & ~wr_full;
+  assign rd_acc = rd_en & ~rd_empty;
+
+  // ------------------------------------------------------------------
+  // Scoreboard state
+  // ------------------------------------------------------------------
+  logic [SEQ_W-1:0]      wr_cnt;        // accepted writes since reset
+  logic [SEQ_W-1:0]      rd_cnt;        // accepted reads since reset
+  logic                  tag_written;
+  logic                  tag_read;
+  logic [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] tag_data;
+
+  // Occupancy, forced to SEQ_W bits so the subtraction wraps correctly
+  logic [SEQ_W-1:0] occ;
+  assign occ = wr_cnt - rd_cnt;
+
+  always_comb begin
+    if (rst_n && wr_reset_done && rd_reset_done &&
+        tag_written && !tag_read) begin
+      assert (wr_cnt != rd_cnt);
+      assert (dut.u_mem.mem[tag_seq[ADDR_WIDTH-1:0]] == tag_data);
+    end
+  end
+
+  always_comb begin
+    assert (dut.u_wr_ptr.wr_full_next ==
+            ((dut.u_wr_ptr.wr_gray_next[ADDR_WIDTH] !=
+              dut.rd_gray_sync[ADDR_WIDTH]) &&
+             (dut.u_wr_ptr.wr_gray_next[ADDR_WIDTH-1] !=
+              dut.rd_gray_sync[ADDR_WIDTH-1]) &&
+             (dut.u_wr_ptr.wr_gray_next[ADDR_WIDTH-2:0] ==
+              dut.rd_gray_sync[ADDR_WIDTH-2:0])));
+  end
+
+  // ---- Write side ----
+  always_ff @(posedge wr_clk) begin
+    if (!rst_n || !wr_reset_done) begin
+      wr_cnt      <= '0;
+      tag_written <= 1'b0;
+      tag_data    <= '0;
+    end else begin
+      assert (wr_cnt == dut.u_wr_ptr.wr_bin);
+      assert (dut.wr_gray_ptr ==
+              (dut.u_wr_ptr.wr_bin ^ (dut.u_wr_ptr.wr_bin >> 1)));
+      assert (occ <= DEPTH);
+
+      if (wr_acc) begin
+        // P2a: no overflow
+        assert (occ < DEPTH);
+
+        if (!tag_written && wr_cnt == tag_seq) begin
+          tag_written <= 1'b1;
+          tag_data    <= wr_data;
+        end
+        wr_cnt <= wr_cnt + 1'b1;
+      end
+    end
+  end
+
+  // ---- Read side ----
+  // rd_data is a combinational read of the slot at the CURRENT read
+  // pointer, so the item being popped at this edge is the pre-edge value.
+  always_ff @(posedge rd_clk) begin
+    if (!rst_n || !rd_reset_done) begin
+      rd_cnt   <= '0;
+      tag_read <= 1'b0;
+    end else begin
+      assert (rd_cnt == dut.u_rd_ptr.rd_bin);
+      assert (dut.rd_gray_ptr ==
+              (dut.u_rd_ptr.rd_bin ^ (dut.u_rd_ptr.rd_bin >> 1)));
+
+      // Both pointers have wrapped past the first lap
+      cover (wr_cnt[ADDR_WIDTH] && rd_cnt[ADDR_WIDTH]);
+
+      if (rd_acc) begin
+        // P2b: no underflow
+        assert (wr_cnt != rd_cnt);
+
+        if (!tag_read && rd_cnt == tag_seq) begin
+          // P2c: integrity, ordering, no loss, no duplication
+          assert (tag_written);
+          assert (rd_data == tag_data);
+
+          // Non-vacuity: the tagged check really fires
+          cover (tag_written);
+          cover (tag_written && tag_seq[ADDR_WIDTH]);
+          tag_read <= 1'b1;
+        end
+        rd_cnt <= rd_cnt + 1'b1;
+      end
+    end
+  end
+
+endmodule

+[options]
+# Free, independent clocks. Without this, sby models every flop as ticking
+# on one shared clock every step, which is NOT a clock-domain-crossing model.
+multiclock on
+
+# Depth is 2**(ADDR_WIDTH+1) + 12 for the default ADDR_WIDTH=4. It must be
+# deep enough to push the highest tag_seq through write, sync and read.
+mode bmc
+depth 44
+
+[engines]
+smtbmc z3
+
+[script]
+plugin -i slang
+read_slang async_fifo.sv async_fifo_integrity_top.sv --top async_fifo_integrity_top
+prep -top async_fifo_integrity_top
+
+[files]
+async_fifo.sv
+async_fifo_integrity_top.sv

+`timescale 1ns / 1ps
+
+
+// ==========================================================================
+// Module 1: Dual-Port RAM
+// ==========================================================================
+module async_fifo_mem #(
+    parameter DATA_WIDTH = 8,
+    parameter ADDR_WIDTH = 4              // Depth = 2**ADDR_WIDTH = 16
+)(
+    input  logic                  wr_clk,
+    input  logic                  wr_en,    // Gated externally: only HIGH when not full
+    input  logic [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] wr_addr,
+    input  logic [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] wr_data,
+    input  logic [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] rd_addr,
+    output logic [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] rd_data
+);
+
+    // ---- Storage array ----
+    logic [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] mem [0:(1<<ADDR_WIDTH)-1];
+
+    // Synchronous write
+    always_ff @(posedge wr_clk) begin
+        if (wr_en)
+            mem[wr_addr] <= wr_data;
+    end
+
+    // Combinational (async) read
+    assign rd_data = mem[rd_addr];
+
+endmodule
+
+
+// ==========================================================================
+// Module 2: 2-Flop Synchronizer
+// ==========================================================================
+module sync_2ff #(
+    parameter WIDTH = 1
+)(
+    input  logic             clk,       // Destination clock
+    input  logic             rst_n,     // Destination reset (active-low)
+    input  logic [WIDTH-1:0] d_in,      // Input from source domain
+    output logic [WIDTH-1:0] q_out      // Synchronized output in dest domain
+);
+
+    // Two-stage pipeline
+    logic [WIDTH-1:0] meta_ff;  // Stage 1 — may go metastable
+    logic [WIDTH-1:0] sync_ff;  // Stage 2 — resolved, safe to use
+
+    always_ff @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
+        if (!rst_n) begin
+            meta_ff <= '0;
+            sync_ff <= '0;
+        end else begin
+            meta_ff <= d_in;
+            sync_ff <= meta_ff;
+        end
+    end
+
+    assign q_out = sync_ff;
+
+endmodule
+
+
+// ==========================================================================
+// Module 3: Write Pointer & Full Flag Generation
+// ==========================================================================
+module async_fifo_wr_ptr #(
+    parameter ADDR_WIDTH = 4
+)(
+    input  logic                    wr_clk,
+    input  logic                    wr_rst_n,
+    input  logic                    wr_en,
+    input  logic [ADDR_WIDTH:0]     rd_gray_sync,
+    output logic [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0]   wr_addr,
+    output logic [ADDR_WIDTH:0]     wr_gray_ptr,
+    output logic                    wr_full
+);
+
+    // Binary pointer: ADDR_WIDTH+1 bits (extra MSB for wrap detection)
+    logic [ADDR_WIDTH:0] wr_bin;
+    logic [ADDR_WIDTH:0] wr_bin_next;
+    logic [ADDR_WIDTH:0] wr_gray_next;
+    logic                wr_full_next;
+
+    // Increment logic
+    assign wr_bin_next  = wr_bin + (wr_en & ~wr_full);
+    assign wr_gray_next = wr_bin_next ^ (wr_bin_next >> 1);
+    assign wr_full_next = (wr_gray_next[ADDR_WIDTH]     != rd_gray_sync[ADDR_WIDTH])   &&
+                          (wr_gray_next[ADDR_WIDTH-1]   != rd_gray_sync[ADDR_WIDTH-1]) &&
+                          (wr_gray_next[ADDR_WIDTH-2:0] == rd_gray_sync[ADDR_WIDTH-2:0]);
+
+    always_ff @(posedge wr_clk or negedge wr_rst_n) begin
+        if (!wr_rst_n) begin
+            wr_bin <= '0;
+            wr_gray_ptr <= '0;
+            wr_full <= 1'b0;
+        end else begin
+            wr_bin <= wr_bin_next;
+            wr_gray_ptr <= wr_gray_next;
+            wr_full <= wr_full_next;
+        end
+    end
+
+    assign wr_addr = wr_bin[ADDR_WIDTH-1:0];
+
+endmodule
+
+
+// ==========================================================================
+// Module 4: Read Pointer & Empty Flag Generation
+// ==========================================================================
+module async_fifo_rd_ptr #(
+    parameter ADDR_WIDTH = 4
+)(
+    input  logic                    rd_clk,
+    input  logic                    rd_rst_n,
+    input  logic                    rd_en,
+    input  logic [ADDR_WIDTH:0]     wr_gray_sync,
+    output logic [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0]   rd_addr,
+    output logic [ADDR_WIDTH:0]     rd_gray_ptr,
+    output logic                    rd_empty
+);
+
+    // Binary pointer: ADDR_WIDTH+1 bits
+    logic [ADDR_WIDTH:0] rd_bin;
+    logic [ADDR_WIDTH:0] rd_bin_next;
+    logic [ADDR_WIDTH:0] rd_gray_next;
+    logic                rd_empty_next;
+
+    assign rd_bin_next = rd_bin + (rd_en & ~rd_empty);
+    assign rd_gray_next = rd_bin_next ^ (rd_bin_next >> 1);
+    assign rd_empty_next = (rd_gray_next == wr_gray_sync);
+
+    always_ff @(posedge rd_clk or negedge rd_rst_n) begin
+        if (!rd_rst_n) begin
+            rd_bin <= '0;
+            rd_gray_ptr <= '0;
+            rd_empty <= 1'b1;
+        end else begin
+            rd_bin <= rd_bin_next;
+            rd_gray_ptr <= rd_gray_next;
+            rd_empty <= rd_empty_next;
+        end
+    end
+
+    assign rd_addr = rd_bin[ADDR_WIDTH-1:0];
+
+endmodule
+
+
+// ==========================================================================
+// Top-Level Module: Asynchronous FIFO
+// ==========================================================================
+module async_fifo #(
+    parameter DATA_WIDTH = 8,
+    parameter ADDR_WIDTH = 4
+)(
+    // Write domain
+    input  logic                  wr_clk,
+    input  logic                  wr_rst_n,
+    input  logic                  wr_en,
+    input  logic [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] wr_data,
+    output logic                  wr_full,
+    // Read domain
+    input  logic                  rd_clk,
+    input  logic                  rd_rst_n,
+    input  logic                  rd_en,
+    output logic [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] rd_data,
+    output logic                  rd_empty
+);
+
+    logic [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] wr_addr;
+    logic [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] rd_addr;
+    logic [ADDR_WIDTH:0]   wr_gray_ptr;
+    logic [ADDR_WIDTH:0]   rd_gray_ptr;
+    logic [ADDR_WIDTH:0]   wr_gray_sync;
+    logic [ADDR_WIDTH:0]   rd_gray_sync;
+
+    logic wr_en_gated;
+
+    assign wr_en_gated = wr_en & ~wr_full;
+
+    // RAM
+    async_fifo_mem #(
+        .DATA_WIDTH(DATA_WIDTH),
+        .ADDR_WIDTH(ADDR_WIDTH)
+    ) u_mem (
+        .wr_clk(wr_clk),
+        .wr_en(wr_en_gated),
+        .wr_addr(wr_addr),
+        .wr_data(wr_data),
+        .rd_addr(rd_addr),
+        .rd_data(rd_data)
+    );
+
+    // Write pointer & full logic
+    async_fifo_wr_ptr #(
+        .ADDR_WIDTH(ADDR_WIDTH)
+    ) u_wr_ptr (
+        .wr_clk(wr_clk),
+        .wr_rst_n(wr_rst_n),
+        .wr_en(wr_en),
+        .rd_gray_sync(rd_gray_sync),
+        .wr_addr(wr_addr),
+        .wr_gray_ptr(wr_gray_ptr),
+        .wr_full(wr_full)
+    );
+
+    // Read pointer & empty logic
+    async_fifo_rd_ptr #(
+        .ADDR_WIDTH(ADDR_WIDTH)
+    ) u_rd_ptr (
+        .rd_clk(rd_clk),
+        .rd_rst_n(rd_rst_n),
+        .rd_en(rd_en),
+        .wr_gray_sync(wr_gray_sync),
+        .rd_addr(rd_addr),
+        .rd_gray_ptr(rd_gray_ptr),
+        .rd_empty(rd_empty)
+    );
+
+    // Synchronizers
+    sync_2ff #(
+        .WIDTH(ADDR_WIDTH + 1)
+    ) u_sync_wr2rd (
+        .clk(rd_clk),
+        .rst_n(rd_rst_n),
+        .d_in(wr_gray_ptr),
+        .q_out(wr_gray_sync)
+    );
+
+    sync_2ff #(
+        .WIDTH(ADDR_WIDTH + 1)
+    ) u_sync_rd2wr (
+        .clk(wr_clk),
+        .rst_n(wr_rst_n),
+        .d_in(rd_gray_ptr),
+        .q_out(rd_gray_sync)
+    );
+
+endmodule

+// async_fifo_integrity_top.sv
+// Phase 2: data-integrity proof for the Gray-code async FIFO.
+//
+// Formal top level. Wraps the unmodified async_fifo, drives it with free
+// inputs, and checks it with a "tagged item" scoreboard.
+//
+// HOW THE CHECK WORKS
+//   The solver picks ONE sequence number (tag_seq) and holds it fixed. The
+//   checker counts accepted writes (wr_cnt) and accepted reads (rd_cnt)
+//   independently of the DUT's own pointers. When write number tag_seq
+//   happens, its data is captured. When read number tag_seq happens, the
+//   data coming out of the FIFO must equal what was captured. Because
+//   tag_seq can be any value, this covers every position in the stream:
+//   a dropped, duplicated, reordered, overwritten or stale item shifts the
+//   numbering and produces a mismatch.
+//
+//   tag_seq has ADDR_WIDTH+1 bits, so it spans two full laps of the memory
+//   (every slot is exercised twice, and every pointer wrap state is hit).
+//   Items beyond 2**(ADDR_WIDTH+1) alias onto the same tag values and are
+//   not individually tracked. State that limit in the paper.
+//
+// ENVIRONMENT ASSUMPTIONS (built structurally, no assume statements)
+//   1. wr_clk and rd_clk are free: any ratio, any phase (needs the
+//      `multiclock on` option in the .sby file).
+//   2. One shared reset, held low until BOTH clocks have ticked at least
+//      once, then released and never asserted again.
+//   3. Reset release timing relative to the clocks is not modeled
+//      (recovery/removal is a physical-design concern).
+//   4. wr_en, wr_data, rd_en are completely free every step.
+//
+// PROPERTIES
+//   P2a  no overflow : an accepted write never happens when the FIFO holds
+//                      DEPTH items
+//   P2b  no underflow: an accepted read never happens when it holds 0 items
+//   P2c  integrity   : the tag_seq-th item read equals the tag_seq-th item
+//                      written (covers ordering, loss, duplication,
+//                      overwrite)
+//   Covers prove the tagged check actually fires, on the second lap too.
+
+module async_fifo_integrity_top #(
+    parameter DATA_WIDTH = 8,
+    parameter ADDR_WIDTH = 4
+) (
+    input logic                  wr_clk,
+    input logic                  rd_clk,
+    input logic                  wr_en,
+    input logic [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] wr_data,
+    input logic                  rd_en,
+    input logic [ADDR_WIDTH:0]   tag_seq_in   // free; sampled once, then frozen
+);
+
+  localparam SEQ_W = ADDR_WIDTH + 1;
+  localparam int DEPTH = 1 << ADDR_WIDTH;
+
+  // ------------------------------------------------------------------
+  // Structural reset: low until both clocks have ticked once, then high
+  // forever. Each domain therefore sees at least one edge while in reset.
+  // ------------------------------------------------------------------
+  logic wr_seen;
+  logic rd_seen;
+  initial begin
+    wr_seen = 1'b0;
+    rd_seen = 1'b0;
+  end
+  always_ff @(posedge wr_clk) wr_seen <= 1'b1;
+  always_ff @(posedge rd_clk) rd_seen <= 1'b1;
+
+  logic rst_n;
+  assign rst_n = wr_seen & rd_seen;
+
+  // ------------------------------------------------------------------
+  // Frozen tag index: take a free input at the first write-clock edge,
+  // then never change it. Behaves like an "any constant" without needing
+  // a frontend-specific attribute.
+  // ------------------------------------------------------------------
+  logic             tag_set;
+  logic [SEQ_W-1:0] tag_seq;
+  initial tag_set = 1'b0;
+  always_ff @(posedge wr_clk) begin
+    if (!tag_set) begin
+      tag_seq <= tag_seq_in;
+      tag_set <= 1'b1;
+    end
+  end
+
+  // ------------------------------------------------------------------
+  // Device under test (unmodified)
+  // ------------------------------------------------------------------
+  logic                  wr_full;
+  logic                  rd_empty;
+  logic [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] rd_data;
+
+  async_fifo #(
+      .DATA_WIDTH(DATA_WIDTH),
+      .ADDR_WIDTH(ADDR_WIDTH)
+  ) dut (
+      .wr_clk  (wr_clk),
+      .wr_rst_n(rst_n),
+      .wr_en   (wr_en),
+      .wr_data (wr_data),
+      .wr_full (wr_full),
+      .rd_clk  (rd_clk),
+      .rd_rst_n(rst_n),
+      .rd_en   (rd_en),
+      .rd_data (rd_data),
+      .rd_empty(rd_empty)
+  );
+
+  // Accepted operations, as seen at the clock edge (pre-edge flag values)
+  logic wr_acc;
+  logic rd_acc;
+  assign wr_acc = wr_en & ~wr_full;
+  assign rd_acc = rd_en & ~rd_empty;
+
+  // ------------------------------------------------------------------
+  // Scoreboard state
+  // ------------------------------------------------------------------
+  logic [SEQ_W-1:0]      wr_cnt;        // accepted writes since reset
+  logic [SEQ_W-1:0]      rd_cnt;        // accepted reads since reset
+  logic                  tag_written;
+  logic                  tag_read;
+  logic [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] tag_data;
+
+  // Occupancy, forced to SEQ_W bits so the subtraction wraps correctly
+  logic [SEQ_W-1:0] occ;
+  assign occ = wr_cnt - rd_cnt;
+
+  // ---- Write side ----
+  always_ff @(posedge wr_clk) begin
+    if (!rst_n) begin
+      wr_cnt      <= '0;
+      tag_written <= 1'b0;
+      tag_data    <= '0;
+    end else if (wr_acc) begin
+      // P2a: no overflow
+      assert (occ < DEPTH);
+
+      if (!tag_written && wr_cnt == tag_seq) begin
+        tag_written <= 1'b1;
+        tag_data    <= wr_data;
+      end
+      wr_cnt <= wr_cnt + 1'b1;
+    end
+  end
+
+  // ---- Read side ----
+  // rd_data is a combinational read of the slot at the CURRENT read
+  // pointer, so the item being popped at this edge is the pre-edge value.
+  always_ff @(posedge rd_clk) begin
+    if (!rst_n) begin
+      rd_cnt   <= '0;
+      tag_read <= 1'b0;
+    end else begin
+      // Both pointers have wrapped past the first lap
+      cover (wr_cnt[ADDR_WIDTH] && rd_cnt[ADDR_WIDTH]);
+
+      if (rd_acc) begin
+        // P2b: no underflow
+        assert (wr_cnt != rd_cnt);
+
+        if (!tag_read && rd_cnt == tag_seq) begin
+          // P2c: integrity, ordering, no loss, no duplication
+          assert (tag_written);
+          assert (rd_data == tag_data);
+
+          // Non-vacuity: the tagged check really fires
+          cover (tag_written);
+          cover (tag_written && tag_seq[ADDR_WIDTH]);
+          tag_read <= 1'b1;
+        end
+        rd_cnt <= rd_cnt + 1'b1;
+      end
+    end
+  end
+
+endmodule

+[options]
+# Free, independent clocks. Without this, sby models every flop as ticking
+# on one shared clock every step, which is NOT a clock-domain-crossing model.
+multiclock on
+
+# Depth is 2**(ADDR_WIDTH+1) + 12 for the default ADDR_WIDTH=4. It must be
+# deep enough to push the highest tag_seq through write, sync and read.
+mode cover
+depth 44
+
+[engines]
+smtbmc z3
+
+[script]
+plugin -i slang
+read_slang async_fifo.sv async_fifo_integrity_top.sv --top async_fifo_integrity_top
+prep -top async_fifo_integrity_top
+
+[files]
+async_fifo.sv
+async_fifo_integrity_top.sv

+
+    // state 10
+    if (cycle == 9) begin
+      PI_rd_clk <= 1'b1;
+      PI_tag_seq_in <= 5'b00001;
+      PI_wr_clk <= 1'b1;
+      PI_rd_en <= 1'b1;
+      PI_wr_data <= 8'b00000000;
+      PI_wr_en <= 1'b1;
+    end
+
+    genclock <= cycle < 10;
+    cycle <= cycle + 1;
+  end
+endmodule

+      PI_wr_clk <= 1'b1;
+      PI_rd_en <= 1'b1;
+      PI_wr_data <= 8'b01000000;
+      PI_wr_en <= 1'b0;
+    end
+
+    // state 42
+    if (cycle == 41) begin
+      PI_rd_clk <= 1'b1;
+      PI_tag_seq_in <= 5'b00000;
+      PI_wr_clk <= 1'b1;
+      PI_rd_en <= 1'b1;
+      PI_wr_data <= 8'b00000000;
+      PI_wr_en <= 1'b1;
+    end
+
+    genclock <= cycle < 42;
+    cycle <= cycle + 1;
+  end
+endmodule

+      PI_wr_data <= 8'b00000000;
+      PI_wr_en <= 1'b0;
+    end
+
+    // state 41
+    if (cycle == 40) begin
+      PI_rd_clk <= 1'b0;
+      PI_tag_seq_in <= 5'b00000;
+      PI_wr_clk <= 1'b1;
+      PI_rd_en <= 1'b1;
+      PI_wr_data <= 8'b00000000;
+      PI_wr_en <= 1'b1;
+    end
+
+    // state 42
+    if (cycle == 41) begin
+      PI_rd_clk <= 1'b1;
+      PI_tag_seq_in <= 5'b00000;
+      PI_wr_clk <= 1'b0;
+      PI_rd_en <= 1'b1;
+      PI_wr_data <= 8'b00000000;
+      PI_wr_en <= 1'b1;
+    end
+
+    genclock <= cycle < 42;
+    cycle <= cycle + 1;
+  end
+endmodule

+`timescale 1ns / 1ps
+
+
+// ==========================================================================
+// Module 1: Dual-Port RAM
+// ==========================================================================
+module async_fifo_mem #(
+    parameter DATA_WIDTH = 8,
+    parameter ADDR_WIDTH = 4              // Depth = 2**ADDR_WIDTH = 16
+)(
+    input  logic                  wr_clk,
+    input  logic                  wr_en,    // Gated externally: only HIGH when not full
+    input  logic [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] wr_addr,
+    input  logic [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] wr_data,
+    input  logic [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] rd_addr,
+    output logic [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] rd_data
+);
+
+    // ---- Storage array ----
+    logic [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] mem [0:(1<<ADDR_WIDTH)-1];
+
+    // Synchronous write
+    always_ff @(posedge wr_clk) begin
+        if (wr_en)
+            mem[wr_addr] <= wr_data;
+    end
+
+    // Combinational (async) read
+    assign rd_data = mem[rd_addr];
+
+endmodule
+
+
+// ==========================================================================
+// Module 2: 2-Flop Synchronizer
+// ==========================================================================
+module sync_2ff #(
+    parameter WIDTH = 1
+)(
+    input  logic             clk,       // Destination clock
+    input  logic             rst_n,     // Destination reset (active-low)
+    input  logic [WIDTH-1:0] d_in,      // Input from source domain
+    output logic [WIDTH-1:0] q_out      // Synchronized output in dest domain
+);
+
+    // Two-stage pipeline
+    logic [WIDTH-1:0] meta_ff;  // Stage 1 — may go metastable
+    logic [WIDTH-1:0] sync_ff;  // Stage 2 — resolved, safe to use
+
+    always_ff @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
+        if (!rst_n) begin
+            meta_ff <= '0;
+            sync_ff <= '0;
+        end else begin
+            meta_ff <= d_in;
+            sync_ff <= meta_ff;
+        end
+    end
+
+    assign q_out = sync_ff;
+
+endmodule
+
+
+// ==========================================================================
+// Module 3: Write Pointer & Full Flag Generation
+// ==========================================================================
+module async_fifo_wr_ptr #(
+    parameter ADDR_WIDTH = 4
+)(
+    input  logic                    wr_clk,
+    input  logic                    wr_rst_n,
+    input  logic                    wr_en,
+    input  logic [ADDR_WIDTH:0]     rd_gray_sync,
+    output logic [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0]   wr_addr,
+    output logic [ADDR_WIDTH:0]     wr_gray_ptr,
+    output logic                    wr_full
+);
+
+    // Binary pointer: ADDR_WIDTH+1 bits (extra MSB for wrap detection)
+    logic [ADDR_WIDTH:0] wr_bin;
+    logic [ADDR_WIDTH:0] wr_bin_next;
+    logic [ADDR_WIDTH:0] wr_gray_next;
+    logic                wr_full_next;
+
+    // Increment logic
+    assign wr_bin_next  = wr_bin + (wr_en & ~wr_full);
+    assign wr_gray_next = wr_bin_next ^ (wr_bin_next >> 1);
+    assign wr_full_next = (wr_gray_next[ADDR_WIDTH]     != rd_gray_sync[ADDR_WIDTH])   &&
+                          (wr_gray_next[ADDR_WIDTH-1]   != rd_gray_sync[ADDR_WIDTH-1]) &&
+                          (wr_gray_next[ADDR_WIDTH-2:0] == rd_gray_sync[ADDR_WIDTH-2:0]);
+
+    always_ff @(posedge wr_clk or negedge wr_rst_n) begin
+        if (!wr_rst_n) begin
+            wr_bin <= '0;
+            wr_gray_ptr <= '0;
+            wr_full <= 1'b0;
+        end else begin
+            wr_bin <= wr_bin_next;
+            wr_gray_ptr <= wr_gray_next;
+            wr_full <= wr_full_next;
+        end
+    end
+
+    assign wr_addr = wr_bin[ADDR_WIDTH-1:0];
+
+endmodule
+
+
+// ==========================================================================
+// Module 4: Read Pointer & Empty Flag Generation
+// ==========================================================================
+module async_fifo_rd_ptr #(
+    parameter ADDR_WIDTH = 4
+)(
+    input  logic                    rd_clk,
+    input  logic                    rd_rst_n,
+    input  logic                    rd_en,
+    input  logic [ADDR_WIDTH:0]     wr_gray_sync,
+    output logic [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0]   rd_addr,
+    output logic [ADDR_WIDTH:0]     rd_gray_ptr,
+    output logic                    rd_empty
+);
+
+    // Binary pointer: ADDR_WIDTH+1 bits
+    logic [ADDR_WIDTH:0] rd_bin;
+    logic [ADDR_WIDTH:0] rd_bin_next;
+    logic [ADDR_WIDTH:0] rd_gray_next;
+    logic                rd_empty_next;
+
+    assign rd_bin_next = rd_bin + (rd_en & ~rd_empty);
+    assign rd_gray_next = rd_bin_next ^ (rd_bin_next >> 1);
+    assign rd_empty_next = (rd_gray_next == wr_gray_sync);
+
+    always_ff @(posedge rd_clk or negedge rd_rst_n) begin
+        if (!rd_rst_n) begin
+            rd_bin <= '0;
+            rd_gray_ptr <= '0;
+            rd_empty <= 1'b1;
+        end else begin
+            rd_bin <= rd_bin_next;
+            rd_gray_ptr <= rd_gray_next;
+            rd_empty <= rd_empty_next;
+        end
+    end
+
+    assign rd_addr = rd_bin[ADDR_WIDTH-1:0];
+
+endmodule
+
+
+// ==========================================================================
+// Top-Level Module: Asynchronous FIFO
+// ==========================================================================
+module async_fifo #(
+    parameter DATA_WIDTH = 8,
+    parameter ADDR_WIDTH = 4
+)(
+    // Write domain
+    input  logic                  wr_clk,
+    input  logic                  wr_rst_n,
+    input  logic                  wr_en,
+    input  logic [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] wr_data,
+    output logic                  wr_full,
+    // Read domain
+    input  logic                  rd_clk,
+    input  logic                  rd_rst_n,
+    input  logic                  rd_en,
+    output logic [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] rd_data,
+    output logic                  rd_empty
+);
+
+    logic [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] wr_addr;
+    logic [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] rd_addr;
+    logic [ADDR_WIDTH:0]   wr_gray_ptr;
+    logic [ADDR_WIDTH:0]   rd_gray_ptr;
+    logic [ADDR_WIDTH:0]   wr_gray_sync;
+    logic [ADDR_WIDTH:0]   rd_gray_sync;
+
+    logic wr_en_gated;
+
+    assign wr_en_gated = wr_en & ~wr_full;
+
+    // RAM
+    async_fifo_mem #(
+        .DATA_WIDTH(DATA_WIDTH),
+        .ADDR_WIDTH(ADDR_WIDTH)
+    ) u_mem (
+        .wr_clk(wr_clk),
+        .wr_en(wr_en_gated),
+        .wr_addr(wr_addr),
+        .wr_data(wr_data),
+        .rd_addr(rd_addr),
+        .rd_data(rd_data)
+    );
+
+    // Write pointer & full logic
+    async_fifo_wr_ptr #(
+        .ADDR_WIDTH(ADDR_WIDTH)
+    ) u_wr_ptr (
+        .wr_clk(wr_clk),
+        .wr_rst_n(wr_rst_n),
+        .wr_en(wr_en),
+        .rd_gray_sync(rd_gray_sync),
+        .wr_addr(wr_addr),
+        .wr_gray_ptr(wr_gray_ptr),
+        .wr_full(wr_full)
+    );
+
+    // Read pointer & empty logic
+    async_fifo_rd_ptr #(
+        .ADDR_WIDTH(ADDR_WIDTH)
+    ) u_rd_ptr (
+        .rd_clk(rd_clk),
+        .rd_rst_n(rd_rst_n),
+        .rd_en(rd_en),
+        .wr_gray_sync(wr_gray_sync),
+        .rd_addr(rd_addr),
+        .rd_gray_ptr(rd_gray_ptr),
+        .rd_empty(rd_empty)
+    );
+
+    // Synchronizers
+    sync_2ff #(
+        .WIDTH(ADDR_WIDTH + 1)
+    ) u_sync_wr2rd (
+        .clk(rd_clk),
+        .rst_n(rd_rst_n),
+        .d_in(wr_gray_ptr),
+        .q_out(wr_gray_sync)
+    );
+
+    sync_2ff #(
+        .WIDTH(ADDR_WIDTH + 1)
+    ) u_sync_rd2wr (
+        .clk(wr_clk),
+        .rst_n(wr_rst_n),
+        .d_in(rd_gray_ptr),
+        .q_out(rd_gray_sync)
+    );
+
+endmodule

+// Phase 2: data-integrity proof for the Gray-code async FIFO.
+//
+// Formal top level. Wraps the unmodified async_fifo, drives it with free
+// inputs, and checks it with a "tagged item" scoreboard.
+//
+// HOW THE CHECK WORKS
+//   The solver picks ONE sequence number (tag_seq) and holds it fixed. The
+//   checker counts accepted writes (wr_cnt) and accepted reads (rd_cnt)
+//   independently of the DUT's own pointers. When write number tag_seq
+//   happens, its data is captured. When read number tag_seq happens, the
+//   data coming out of the FIFO must equal what was captured. Because
+//   tag_seq can be any value, this covers every position in the stream:
+//   a dropped, duplicated, reordered, overwritten or stale item shifts the
+//   numbering and produces a mismatch.
+//
+//   tag_seq has ADDR_WIDTH+1 bits, so it spans two full laps of the memory
+//   (every slot is exercised twice, and every pointer wrap state is hit).
+//   Items beyond 2**(ADDR_WIDTH+1) alias onto the same tag values and are
+//   not individually tracked. State that limit in the paper.
+//
+// ENVIRONMENT ASSUMPTIONS (built structurally, no assume statements)
+//   1. wr_clk and rd_clk are free: any ratio, any phase (needs the
+//      `multiclock on` option in the .sby file).
+//   2. One shared reset, held low until BOTH clocks have ticked at least
+//      once, then released and never asserted again.
+//   3. Reset release timing relative to the clocks is not modeled
+//      (recovery/removal is a physical-design concern).
+//   4. wr_en, wr_data, rd_en are completely free every step.
+//
+// PROPERTIES
+//   P2a  no overflow : an accepted write never happens when the FIFO holds
+//                      DEPTH items
+//   P2b  no underflow: an accepted read never happens when it holds 0 items
+//   P2c  integrity   : the tag_seq-th item read equals the tag_seq-th item
+//                      written (covers ordering, loss, duplication,
+//                      overwrite)
+//   Covers prove the tagged check actually fires, on the second lap too.
+
+module async_fifo_integrity_top #(
+    parameter DATA_WIDTH = 8,
+    parameter ADDR_WIDTH = 4
+) (
+    input logic                  wr_clk,
+    input logic                  rd_clk,
+    input logic                  wr_en,
+    input logic [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] wr_data,
+    input logic                  rd_en,
+    input logic [ADDR_WIDTH:0]   tag_seq_in   // free; sampled once, then frozen
+);
+
+  localparam SEQ_W = ADDR_WIDTH + 1;
+  localparam int DEPTH = 1 << ADDR_WIDTH;
+
+  // ------------------------------------------------------------------
+  // Structural reset: low until both clocks have ticked once, then high
+  // forever. Each domain therefore sees at least one edge while in reset.
+  // ------------------------------------------------------------------
+  logic wr_seen;
+  logic rd_seen;
+  initial begin
+    wr_seen = 1'b0;
+    rd_seen = 1'b0;
+  end
+  always_ff @(posedge wr_clk) wr_seen <= 1'b1;
+  always_ff @(posedge rd_clk) rd_seen <= 1'b1;
+
+  logic rst_n;
+  assign rst_n = wr_seen & rd_seen;
+
+  // ------------------------------------------------------------------
+  // Frozen tag index: take a free input at the first write-clock edge,
+  // then never change it. Behaves like an "any constant" without needing
+  // a frontend-specific attribute.
+  // ------------------------------------------------------------------
+  logic             tag_set;
+  logic [SEQ_W-1:0] tag_seq;
+  initial tag_set = 1'b0;
+  always_ff @(posedge wr_clk) begin
+    if (!tag_set) begin
+      tag_seq <= tag_seq_in;
+      tag_set <= 1'b1;
+    end
+  end
+
+  // ------------------------------------------------------------------
+  // Device under test (unmodified)
+  // ------------------------------------------------------------------
+  logic                  wr_full;
+  logic                  rd_empty;
+  logic [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] rd_data;
+
+  async_fifo #(
+      .DATA_WIDTH(DATA_WIDTH),
+      .ADDR_WIDTH(ADDR_WIDTH)
+  ) dut (
+      .wr_clk  (wr_clk),
+      .wr_rst_n(rst_n),
+      .wr_en   (wr_en),
+      .wr_data (wr_data),
+      .wr_full (wr_full),
+      .rd_clk  (rd_clk),
+      .rd_rst_n(rst_n),
+      .rd_en   (rd_en),
+      .rd_data (rd_data),
+      .rd_empty(rd_empty)
+  );
+
+  // Accepted operations, as seen at the clock edge (pre-edge flag values)
+  logic wr_acc;
+  logic rd_acc;
+  assign wr_acc = wr_en & ~wr_full;
+  assign rd_acc = rd_en & ~rd_empty;
+
+  // ------------------------------------------------------------------
+  // Scoreboard state
+  // ------------------------------------------------------------------
+  logic [SEQ_W-1:0]      wr_cnt;        // accepted writes since reset
+  logic [SEQ_W-1:0]      rd_cnt;        // accepted reads since reset
+  logic                  tag_written;
+  logic                  tag_read;
+  logic [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] tag_data;
+
+  // Occupancy, forced to SEQ_W bits so the subtraction wraps correctly
+  logic [SEQ_W-1:0] occ;
+  assign occ = wr_cnt - rd_cnt;
+
+  // ---- Write side ----
+  always_ff @(posedge wr_clk) begin
+    if (!rst_n) begin
+      wr_cnt      <= '0;
+      tag_written <= 1'b0;
+      tag_data    <= '0;
+    end else if (wr_acc) begin
+      // P2a: no overflow
+      assert (occ < DEPTH);
+
+      if (!tag_written && wr_cnt == tag_seq) begin
+        tag_written <= 1'b1;
+        tag_data    <= wr_data;
+      end
+      wr_cnt <= wr_cnt + 1'b1;
+    end
+  end
+
+  // ---- Read side ----
+  // rd_data is a combinational read of the slot at the CURRENT read
+  // pointer, so the item being popped at this edge is the pre-edge value.
+  always_ff @(posedge rd_clk) begin
+    if (!rst_n) begin
+      rd_cnt   <= '0;
+      tag_read <= 1'b0;
+    end else begin
+      // Both pointers have wrapped past the first lap
+      cover (wr_cnt[ADDR_WIDTH] && rd_cnt[ADDR_WIDTH]);
+
+      if (rd_acc) begin
+        // P2b: no underflow
+        assert (wr_cnt != rd_cnt);
+
+        if (!tag_read && rd_cnt == tag_seq) begin
+          // P2c: integrity, ordering, no loss, no duplication
+          assert (tag_written);
+          assert (rd_data == tag_data);
+
+          // Non-vacuity: the tagged check really fires
+          cover (tag_written);
+          cover (tag_written && tag_seq[ADDR_WIDTH]);
+          tag_read <= 1'b1;
+        end
+        rd_cnt <= rd_cnt + 1'b1;
+      end
+    end
+  end
+
+endmodule

+`timescale 1ns / 1ps
+
+
+// ==========================================================================
+// Module 1: Dual-Port RAM
+// ==========================================================================
+module async_fifo_mem #(
+    parameter DATA_WIDTH = 8,
+    parameter ADDR_WIDTH = 4              // Depth = 2**ADDR_WIDTH = 16
+)(
+    input  logic                  wr_clk,
+    input  logic                  wr_en,    // Gated externally: only HIGH when not full
+    input  logic [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] wr_addr,
+    input  logic [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] wr_data,
+    input  logic [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] rd_addr,
+    output logic [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] rd_data
+);
+
+    // ---- Storage array ----
+    logic [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] mem [0:(1<<ADDR_WIDTH)-1];
+
+    // Synchronous write
+    always_ff @(posedge wr_clk) begin
+        if (wr_en)
+            mem[wr_addr] <= wr_data;
+    end
+
+    // Combinational (async) read
+    assign rd_data = mem[rd_addr];
+
+endmodule
+
+
+// ==========================================================================
+// Module 2: 2-Flop Synchronizer
+// ==========================================================================
+module sync_2ff #(
+    parameter WIDTH = 1
+)(
+    input  logic             clk,       // Destination clock
+    input  logic             rst_n,     // Destination reset (active-low)
+    input  logic [WIDTH-1:0] d_in,      // Input from source domain
+    output logic [WIDTH-1:0] q_out      // Synchronized output in dest domain
+);
+
+    // Two-stage pipeline
+    logic [WIDTH-1:0] meta_ff;  // Stage 1 — may go metastable
+    logic [WIDTH-1:0] sync_ff;  // Stage 2 — resolved, safe to use
+
+    always_ff @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
+        if (!rst_n) begin
+            meta_ff <= '0;
+            sync_ff <= '0;
+        end else begin
+            meta_ff <= d_in;
+            sync_ff <= meta_ff;
+        end
+    end
+
+    assign q_out = sync_ff;
+
+endmodule
+
+
+// ==========================================================================
+// Module 3: Write Pointer & Full Flag Generation
+// ==========================================================================
+module async_fifo_wr_ptr #(
+    parameter ADDR_WIDTH = 4
+)(
+    input  logic                    wr_clk,
+    input  logic                    wr_rst_n,
+    input  logic                    wr_en,
+    input  logic [ADDR_WIDTH:0]     rd_gray_sync,
+    output logic [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0]   wr_addr,
+    output logic [ADDR_WIDTH:0]     wr_gray_ptr,
+    output logic                    wr_full
+);
+
+    // Binary pointer: ADDR_WIDTH+1 bits (extra MSB for wrap detection)
+    logic [ADDR_WIDTH:0] wr_bin;
+    logic [ADDR_WIDTH:0] wr_bin_next;
+    logic [ADDR_WIDTH:0] wr_gray_next;
+    logic                wr_full_next;
+
+    // Increment logic
+    assign wr_bin_next  = wr_bin + (wr_en & ~wr_full);
+    assign wr_gray_next = wr_bin_next ^ (wr_bin_next >> 1);
+    assign wr_full_next = (wr_gray_next[ADDR_WIDTH]     != rd_gray_sync[ADDR_WIDTH])   &&
+                          (wr_gray_next[ADDR_WIDTH-1]   != rd_gray_sync[ADDR_WIDTH-1]) &&
+                          (wr_gray_next[ADDR_WIDTH-2:0] == rd_gray_sync[ADDR_WIDTH-2:0]);
+
+    always_ff @(posedge wr_clk or negedge wr_rst_n) begin
+        if (!wr_rst_n) begin
+            wr_bin <= '0;
+            wr_gray_ptr <= '0;
+            wr_full <= 1'b0;
+        end else begin
+            wr_bin <= wr_bin_next;
+            wr_gray_ptr <= wr_gray_next;
+            wr_full <= wr_full_next;
+        end
+    end
+
+    assign wr_addr = wr_bin[ADDR_WIDTH-1:0];
+
+endmodule
+
+
+// ==========================================================================
+// Module 4: Read Pointer & Empty Flag Generation
+// ==========================================================================
+module async_fifo_rd_ptr #(
+    parameter ADDR_WIDTH = 4
+)(
+    input  logic                    rd_clk,
+    input  logic                    rd_rst_n,
+    input  logic                    rd_en,
+    input  logic [ADDR_WIDTH:0]     wr_gray_sync,
+    output logic [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0]   rd_addr,
+    output logic [ADDR_WIDTH:0]     rd_gray_ptr,
+    output logic                    rd_empty
+);
+
+    // Binary pointer: ADDR_WIDTH+1 bits
+    logic [ADDR_WIDTH:0] rd_bin;
+    logic [ADDR_WIDTH:0] rd_bin_next;
+    logic [ADDR_WIDTH:0] rd_gray_next;
+    logic                rd_empty_next;
+
+    assign rd_bin_next = rd_bin + (rd_en & ~rd_empty);
+    assign rd_gray_next = rd_bin_next ^ (rd_bin_next >> 1);
+    assign rd_empty_next = (rd_gray_next == wr_gray_sync);
+
+    always_ff @(posedge rd_clk or negedge rd_rst_n) begin
+        if (!rd_rst_n) begin
+            rd_bin <= '0;
+            rd_gray_ptr <= '0;
+            rd_empty <= 1'b1;
+        end else begin
+            rd_bin <= rd_bin_next;
+            rd_gray_ptr <= rd_gray_next;
+            rd_empty <= rd_empty_next;
+        end
+    end
+
+    assign rd_addr = rd_bin[ADDR_WIDTH-1:0];
+
+endmodule
+
+
+// ==========================================================================
+// Top-Level Module: Asynchronous FIFO
+// ==========================================================================
+module async_fifo #(
+    parameter DATA_WIDTH = 8,
+    parameter ADDR_WIDTH = 4
+)(
+    // Write domain
+    input  logic                  wr_clk,
+    input  logic                  wr_rst_n,
+    input  logic                  wr_en,
+    input  logic [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] wr_data,
+    output logic                  wr_full,
+    // Read domain
+    input  logic                  rd_clk,
+    input  logic                  rd_rst_n,
+    input  logic                  rd_en,
+    output logic [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] rd_data,
+    output logic                  rd_empty
+);
+
+    logic [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] wr_addr;
+    logic [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] rd_addr;
+    logic [ADDR_WIDTH:0]   wr_gray_ptr;
+    logic [ADDR_WIDTH:0]   rd_gray_ptr;
+    logic [ADDR_WIDTH:0]   wr_gray_sync;
+    logic [ADDR_WIDTH:0]   rd_gray_sync;
+
+    logic wr_en_gated;
+
+    assign wr_en_gated = wr_en & ~wr_full;
+
+    // RAM
+    async_fifo_mem #(
+        .DATA_WIDTH(DATA_WIDTH),
+        .ADDR_WIDTH(ADDR_WIDTH)
+    ) u_mem (
+        .wr_clk(wr_clk),
+        .wr_en(wr_en_gated),
+        .wr_addr(wr_addr),
+        .wr_data(wr_data),
+        .rd_addr(rd_addr),
+        .rd_data(rd_data)
+    );
+
+    // Write pointer & full logic
+    async_fifo_wr_ptr #(
+        .ADDR_WIDTH(ADDR_WIDTH)
+    ) u_wr_ptr (
+        .wr_clk(wr_clk),
+        .wr_rst_n(wr_rst_n),
+        .wr_en(wr_en),
+        .rd_gray_sync(rd_gray_sync),
+        .wr_addr(wr_addr),
+        .wr_gray_ptr(wr_gray_ptr),
+        .wr_full(wr_full)
+    );
+
+    // Read pointer & empty logic
+    async_fifo_rd_ptr #(
+        .ADDR_WIDTH(ADDR_WIDTH)
+    ) u_rd_ptr (
+        .rd_clk(rd_clk),
+        .rd_rst_n(rd_rst_n),
+        .rd_en(rd_en),
+        .wr_gray_sync(wr_gray_sync),
+        .rd_addr(rd_addr),
+        .rd_gray_ptr(rd_gray_ptr),
+        .rd_empty(rd_empty)
+    );
+
+    // Synchronizers
+    sync_2ff #(
+        .WIDTH(ADDR_WIDTH + 1)
+    ) u_sync_wr2rd (
+        .clk(rd_clk),
+        .rst_n(rd_rst_n),
+        .d_in(wr_gray_ptr),
+        .q_out(wr_gray_sync)
+    );
+
+    sync_2ff #(
+        .WIDTH(ADDR_WIDTH + 1)
+    ) u_sync_rd2wr (
+        .clk(wr_clk),
+        .rst_n(wr_rst_n),
+        .d_in(rd_gray_ptr),
+        .q_out(rd_gray_sync)
+    );
+
+endmodule

+`timescale 1ns / 1ps
+
+
+// ==========================================================================
+// Module 1: Dual-Port RAM
+// ==========================================================================
+module async_fifo_mem #(
+    parameter DATA_WIDTH = 8,
+    parameter ADDR_WIDTH = 4              // Depth = 2**ADDR_WIDTH = 16
+)(
+    input  logic                  wr_clk,
+    input  logic                  wr_en,    // Gated externally: only HIGH when not full
+    input  logic [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] wr_addr,
+    input  logic [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] wr_data,
+    input  logic [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] rd_addr,
+    output logic [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] rd_data
+);
+
+    // ---- Storage array ----
+    logic [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] mem [0:(1<<ADDR_WIDTH)-1];
+
+    // Synchronous write
+    always_ff @(posedge wr_clk) begin
+        if (wr_en)
+            mem[wr_addr] <= wr_data;
+    end
+
+    // Combinational (async) read
+    assign rd_data = mem[rd_addr];
+
+endmodule
+
+
+// ==========================================================================
+// Module 2: 2-Flop Synchronizer
+// ==========================================================================
+module sync_2ff #(
+    parameter WIDTH = 1
+)(
+    input  logic             clk,       // Destination clock
+    input  logic             rst_n,     // Destination reset (active-low)
+    input  logic [WIDTH-1:0] d_in,      // Input from source domain
+    output logic [WIDTH-1:0] q_out      // Synchronized output in dest domain
+);
+
+    // Two-stage pipeline
+    logic [WIDTH-1:0] meta_ff;  // Stage 1 — may go metastable
+    logic [WIDTH-1:0] sync_ff;  // Stage 2 — resolved, safe to use
+
+    always_ff @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
+        if (!rst_n) begin
+            meta_ff <= '0;
+            sync_ff <= '0;
+        end else begin
+            meta_ff <= d_in;
+            sync_ff <= meta_ff;
+        end
+    end
+
+    assign q_out = sync_ff;
+
+endmodule
+
+
+// ==========================================================================
+// Module 3: Write Pointer & Full Flag Generation
+// ==========================================================================
+module async_fifo_wr_ptr #(
+    parameter ADDR_WIDTH = 4
+)(
+    input  logic                    wr_clk,
+    input  logic                    wr_rst_n,
+    input  logic                    wr_en,
+    input  logic [ADDR_WIDTH:0]     rd_gray_sync,
+    output logic [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0]   wr_addr,
+    output logic [ADDR_WIDTH:0]     wr_gray_ptr,
+    output logic                    wr_full
+);
+
+    // Binary pointer: ADDR_WIDTH+1 bits (extra MSB for wrap detection)
+    logic [ADDR_WIDTH:0] wr_bin;
+    logic [ADDR_WIDTH:0] wr_bin_next;
+    logic [ADDR_WIDTH:0] wr_gray_next;
+    logic                wr_full_next;
+
+    // Increment logic
+    assign wr_bin_next  = wr_bin + (wr_en & ~wr_full);
+    assign wr_gray_next = wr_bin_next ^ (wr_bin_next >> 1);
+    assign wr_full_next = (wr_gray_next[ADDR_WIDTH]     != rd_gray_sync[ADDR_WIDTH])   &&
+                          (wr_gray_next[ADDR_WIDTH-1]   != rd_gray_sync[ADDR_WIDTH-1]) &&
+                          (wr_gray_next[ADDR_WIDTH-2:0] == rd_gray_sync[ADDR_WIDTH-2:0]);
+
+    always_ff @(posedge wr_clk or negedge wr_rst_n) begin
+        if (!wr_rst_n) begin
+            wr_bin <= '0;
+            wr_gray_ptr <= '0;
+            wr_full <= 1'b0;
+        end else begin
+            wr_bin <= wr_bin_next;
+            wr_gray_ptr <= wr_gray_next;
+            wr_full <= wr_full_next;
+        end
+    end
+
+    assign wr_addr = wr_bin[ADDR_WIDTH-1:0];
+
+endmodule
+
+
+// ==========================================================================
+// Module 4: Read Pointer & Empty Flag Generation
+// ==========================================================================
+module async_fifo_rd_ptr #(
+    parameter ADDR_WIDTH = 4
+)(
+    input  logic                    rd_clk,
+    input  logic                    rd_rst_n,
+    input  logic                    rd_en,
+    input  logic [ADDR_WIDTH:0]     wr_gray_sync,
+    output logic [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0]   rd_addr,
+    output logic [ADDR_WIDTH:0]     rd_gray_ptr,
+    output logic                    rd_empty
+);
+
+    // Binary pointer: ADDR_WIDTH+1 bits
+    logic [ADDR_WIDTH:0] rd_bin;
+    logic [ADDR_WIDTH:0] rd_bin_next;
+    logic [ADDR_WIDTH:0] rd_gray_next;
+    logic                rd_empty_next;
+
+    assign rd_bin_next = rd_bin + (rd_en & ~rd_empty);
+    assign rd_gray_next = rd_bin_next ^ (rd_bin_next >> 1);
+    assign rd_empty_next = (rd_gray_next == wr_gray_sync);
+
+    always_ff @(posedge rd_clk or negedge rd_rst_n) begin
+        if (!rd_rst_n) begin
+            rd_bin <= '0;
+            rd_gray_ptr <= '0;
+            rd_empty <= 1'b1;
+        end else begin
+            rd_bin <= rd_bin_next;
+            rd_gray_ptr <= rd_gray_next;
+            rd_empty <= rd_empty_next;
+        end
+    end
+
+    assign rd_addr = rd_bin[ADDR_WIDTH-1:0];
+
+endmodule
+
+
+// ==========================================================================
+// Top-Level Module: Asynchronous FIFO
+// ==========================================================================
+module async_fifo #(
+    parameter DATA_WIDTH = 8,
+    parameter ADDR_WIDTH = 4
+)(
+    // Write domain
+    input  logic                  wr_clk,
+    input  logic                  wr_rst_n,
+    input  logic                  wr_en,
+    input  logic [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] wr_data,
+    output logic                  wr_full,
+    // Read domain
+    input  logic                  rd_clk,
+    input  logic                  rd_rst_n,
+    input  logic                  rd_en,
+    output logic [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] rd_data,
+    output logic                  rd_empty
+);
+
+    logic [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] wr_addr;
+    logic [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] rd_addr;
+    logic [ADDR_WIDTH:0]   wr_gray_ptr;
+    logic [ADDR_WIDTH:0]   rd_gray_ptr;
+    logic [ADDR_WIDTH:0]   wr_gray_sync;
+    logic [ADDR_WIDTH:0]   rd_gray_sync;
+
+    logic wr_en_gated;
+
+    assign wr_en_gated = wr_en & ~wr_full;
+
+    // RAM
+    async_fifo_mem #(
+        .DATA_WIDTH(DATA_WIDTH),
+        .ADDR_WIDTH(ADDR_WIDTH)
+    ) u_mem (
+        .wr_clk(wr_clk),
+        .wr_en(wr_en_gated),
+        .wr_addr(wr_addr),
+        .wr_data(wr_data),
+        .rd_addr(rd_addr),
+        .rd_data(rd_data)
+    );
+
+    // Write pointer & full logic
+    async_fifo_wr_ptr #(
+        .ADDR_WIDTH(ADDR_WIDTH)
+    ) u_wr_ptr (
+        .wr_clk(wr_clk),
+        .wr_rst_n(wr_rst_n),
+        .wr_en(wr_en),
+        .rd_gray_sync(rd_gray_sync),
+        .wr_addr(wr_addr),
+        .wr_gray_ptr(wr_gray_ptr),
+        .wr_full(wr_full)
+    );
+
+    // Read pointer & empty logic
+    async_fifo_rd_ptr #(
+        .ADDR_WIDTH(ADDR_WIDTH)
+    ) u_rd_ptr (
+        .rd_clk(rd_clk),
+        .rd_rst_n(rd_rst_n),
+        .rd_en(rd_en),
+        .wr_gray_sync(wr_gray_sync),
+        .rd_addr(rd_addr),
+        .rd_gray_ptr(rd_gray_ptr),
+        .rd_empty(rd_empty)
+    );
+
+    // Synchronizers
+    sync_2ff #(
+        .WIDTH(ADDR_WIDTH + 1)
+    ) u_sync_wr2rd (
+        .clk(rd_clk),
+        .rst_n(rd_rst_n),
+        .d_in(wr_gray_ptr),
+        .q_out(wr_gray_sync)
+    );
+
+    sync_2ff #(
+        .WIDTH(ADDR_WIDTH + 1)
+    ) u_sync_rd2wr (
+        .clk(wr_clk),
+        .rst_n(wr_rst_n),
+        .d_in(rd_gray_ptr),
+        .q_out(rd_gray_sync)
+    );
+
+endmodule

+// async_fifo_formal.sv (v3)
+// Formal property set for the Gray-code CDC async FIFO, Phase 1.
+//
+// v1 used concurrent SVA (assert property / $past / $rose / $fell) --
+// unsupported by yosys-slang's current synthesis path.
+// v2 switched to immediate assertions, but relied on `initial assume
+// (!wr_rst_n)` to force a known-good starting state -- also unsupported
+// ("reading net state during design initialization unsupported"), since
+// an `initial` block can only set register values, not sample a live
+// input signal (there's no such thing as "the input's value before
+// time begins" in real hardware).
+//
+// v3 fixes this properly: a STICKY "have we ever actually observed a
+// real reset" flag per domain, set permanently to 1 the first time
+// rst_n is seen low at any clock edge. Checks are only enabled once
+// that flag is set. This is arguably the more correct technique anyway
+// -- it doesn't force reset to happen at exactly time 0, only requires
+// it to have happened at some point in the design's history before we
+// start trusting internal-register consistency, which is the actual
+// real-world guarantee.
+//
+// Properties covered:
+//   1. Gray-code one-bit-change invariant (wr and rd domains)
+//   2. Reset behavior: wr_full low / rd_empty high on the first cycle
+//      after each domain's reset releases
+//   3. wr_full / rd_empty exactly match the Gray-comparison formula,
+//      using the manually-tracked previous-cycle synchronized pointer
+//   4. Cover: prove full is reachable, prove recovery from full, prove
+//      empty is reached again after data has flowed through
+
+module async_fifo_formal #(
+    parameter ADDR_WIDTH = 4
+) (
+    // Write domain
+    input logic                  wr_clk,
+    input logic                  wr_rst_n,
+    input logic                  wr_en,
+    input logic                  wr_full,
+    input logic [ADDR_WIDTH:0]   wr_gray_ptr,
+    input logic [ADDR_WIDTH:0]   rd_gray_sync,
+    // Read domain
+    input logic                  rd_clk,
+    input logic                  rd_rst_n,
+    input logic                  rd_en,
+    input logic                  rd_empty,
+    input logic [ADDR_WIDTH:0]   rd_gray_ptr,
+    input logic [ADDR_WIDTH:0]   wr_gray_sync
+);
+
+  // ================== Write-domain checker ==================
+  logic [ADDR_WIDTH:0] wr_gray_ptr_prev;
+  logic [ADDR_WIDTH:0] rd_gray_sync_prev;
+  logic                wr_full_prev;
+  logic                wr_rst_n_prev;
+  logic                wr_have_reset;
+  logic [ADDR_WIDTH:0] wr_gray_diff;
+
+  initial wr_have_reset = 1'b0;
+
+  always_ff @(posedge wr_clk) begin
+    // Only trust history once a real reset has actually been observed
+    // at some point -- otherwise the solver is free to start wr_bin
+    // and wr_gray_ptr at two unrelated arbitrary values, which breaks
+    // any comparison for reasons that have nothing to do with the RTL.
+    if (wr_have_reset) begin
+      if (wr_rst_n) begin
+        if (wr_rst_n_prev) begin
+          // Both this cycle and the previous one are out of reset --
+          // safe to compare against tracked history.
+
+          // 1. Gray one-bit-change invariant -- the property that makes
+          // crossing this pointer through a 2-flop synchronizer safe.
+          // (diff & (diff-1)) == 0 is true iff diff is zero or a single
+          // bit -- the same semantics as $onehot0, without relying on
+          // that system task (unsupported by the current frontend).
+          wr_gray_diff = wr_gray_ptr ^ wr_gray_ptr_prev;
+          assert ((wr_gray_diff & (wr_gray_diff - 1'b1)) == '0);
+
+          // 3. wr_full must exactly match the Gray-comparison formula,
+          // using rd_gray_sync as it stood one wr_clk cycle ago (that's
+          // the value actually captured into wr_full_next on that edge).
+          assert (wr_full == (
+            (wr_gray_ptr[ADDR_WIDTH]     != rd_gray_sync_prev[ADDR_WIDTH])   &&
+            (wr_gray_ptr[ADDR_WIDTH-1]   != rd_gray_sync_prev[ADDR_WIDTH-1]) &&
+            (wr_gray_ptr[ADDR_WIDTH-2:0] == rd_gray_sync_prev[ADDR_WIDTH-2:0])
+          ));
+        end else begin
+          // 2. First active cycle after reset release: must start "not full".
+          assert (!wr_full);
+        end
+
+        // 4. Cover: full is reachable, and recovery from full is reachable.
+        cover (wr_full);
+        cover (wr_full_prev && !wr_full);
+      end
+      // else: currently in reset -- async reset can snap pointers to 0
+      // between any two samples, so no invariant is expected to hold
+      // this cycle. Skip checks entirely until reset is released again.
+    end
+
+    wr_gray_ptr_prev  <= wr_gray_ptr;
+    rd_gray_sync_prev <= rd_gray_sync;
+    wr_full_prev      <= wr_full;
+    wr_rst_n_prev     <= wr_rst_n;
+    wr_have_reset     <= wr_have_reset | !wr_rst_n;
+  end
+
+  // ================== Read-domain checker ==================
+  logic [ADDR_WIDTH:0] rd_gray_ptr_prev;
+  logic [ADDR_WIDTH:0] wr_gray_sync_prev;
+  logic                rd_empty_prev;
+  logic                rd_rst_n_prev;
+  logic                rd_have_reset;
+  logic [ADDR_WIDTH:0] rd_gray_diff;
+
+  initial rd_have_reset = 1'b0;
+
+  always_ff @(posedge rd_clk) begin
+    if (rd_have_reset) begin
+      if (rd_rst_n) begin
+        if (rd_rst_n_prev) begin
+          // Both this cycle and the previous one are out of reset --
+          // safe to compare against tracked history.
+
+          // 1. Gray one-bit-change invariant, read domain.
+          rd_gray_diff = rd_gray_ptr ^ rd_gray_ptr_prev;
+          assert ((rd_gray_diff & (rd_gray_diff - 1'b1)) == '0);
+
+          // 3. rd_empty must exactly match the Gray-comparison formula,
+          // using wr_gray_sync as it stood one rd_clk cycle ago.
+          assert (rd_empty == (rd_gray_ptr == wr_gray_sync_prev));
+        end else begin
+          // 2. First active cycle after reset release: must start "empty".
+          assert (rd_empty);
+        end
+
+        // 4. Cover: empty is reached again after having been non-empty
+        // (i.e. data flowed through and was fully drained at least once).
+        cover (!rd_empty_prev && rd_empty);
+      end
+      // else: currently in reset -- skip checks entirely, same reasoning
+      // as the write domain above.
+    end
+
+    rd_gray_ptr_prev  <= rd_gray_ptr;
+    wr_gray_sync_prev <= wr_gray_sync;
+    rd_empty_prev     <= rd_empty;
+    rd_rst_n_prev     <= rd_rst_n;
+    rd_have_reset     <= rd_have_reset | !rd_rst_n;
+  end
+
+endmodule
+
+bind async_fifo async_fifo_formal #(
+    .ADDR_WIDTH(ADDR_WIDTH)
+) u_formal (.*);

+`ifndef VERILATOR

+  initial genclock = 1;
+`endif

+`timescale 1ns / 1ps
+
+
+// ==========================================================================
+// Module 1: Dual-Port RAM
+// ==========================================================================
+module async_fifo_mem #(
+    parameter DATA_WIDTH = 8,
+    parameter ADDR_WIDTH = 4              // Depth = 2**ADDR_WIDTH = 16
+)(
+    input  logic                  wr_clk,
+    input  logic                  wr_en,    // Gated externally: only HIGH when not full
+    input  logic [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] wr_addr,
+    input  logic [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] wr_data,
+    input  logic [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] rd_addr,
+    output logic [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] rd_data
+);
+
+    // ---- Storage array ----
+    logic [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] mem [0:(1<<ADDR_WIDTH)-1];
+
+    // Synchronous write
+    always_ff @(posedge wr_clk) begin
+        if (wr_en)
+            mem[wr_addr] <= wr_data;
+    end
+
+    // Combinational (async) read
+    assign rd_data = mem[rd_addr];
+
+endmodule
+
+
+// ==========================================================================
+// Module 2: 2-Flop Synchronizer
+// ==========================================================================
+module sync_2ff #(
+    parameter WIDTH = 1
+)(
+    input  logic             clk,       // Destination clock
+    input  logic             rst_n,     // Destination reset (active-low)
+    input  logic [WIDTH-1:0] d_in,      // Input from source domain
+    output logic [WIDTH-1:0] q_out      // Synchronized output in dest domain
+);
+
+    // Two-stage pipeline
+    logic [WIDTH-1:0] meta_ff;  // Stage 1 — may go metastable
+    logic [WIDTH-1:0] sync_ff;  // Stage 2 — resolved, safe to use
+
+    always_ff @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
+        if (!rst_n) begin
+            meta_ff <= '0;
+            sync_ff <= '0;
+        end else begin
+            meta_ff <= d_in;
+            sync_ff <= meta_ff;
+        end
+    end
+
+    assign q_out = sync_ff;
+
+endmodule
+
+
+// ==========================================================================
+// Module 3: Write Pointer & Full Flag Generation
+// ==========================================================================
+module async_fifo_wr_ptr #(
+    parameter ADDR_WIDTH = 4
+)(
+    input  logic                    wr_clk,
+    input  logic                    wr_rst_n,
+    input  logic                    wr_en,
+    input  logic [ADDR_WIDTH:0]     rd_gray_sync,
+    output logic [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0]   wr_addr,
+    output logic [ADDR_WIDTH:0]     wr_gray_ptr,
+    output logic                    wr_full
+);
+
+    // Binary pointer: ADDR_WIDTH+1 bits (extra MSB for wrap detection)
+    logic [ADDR_WIDTH:0] wr_bin;
+    logic [ADDR_WIDTH:0] wr_bin_next;
+    logic [ADDR_WIDTH:0] wr_gray_next;
+    logic                wr_full_next;
+
+    // Increment logic
+    assign wr_bin_next  = wr_bin + (wr_en & ~wr_full);
+    assign wr_gray_next = wr_bin_next ^ (wr_bin_next >> 1);
+    assign wr_full_next = (wr_gray_next[ADDR_WIDTH]     != rd_gray_sync[ADDR_WIDTH])   &&
+                          (wr_gray_next[ADDR_WIDTH-1]   != rd_gray_sync[ADDR_WIDTH-1]) &&
+                          (wr_gray_next[ADDR_WIDTH-2:0] == rd_gray_sync[ADDR_WIDTH-2:0]);
+
+    always_ff @(posedge wr_clk or negedge wr_rst_n) begin
+        if (!wr_rst_n) begin
+            wr_bin <= '0;
+            wr_gray_ptr <= '0;
+            wr_full <= 1'b0;
+        end else begin
+            wr_bin <= wr_bin_next;
+            wr_gray_ptr <= wr_gray_next;
+            wr_full <= wr_full_next;
+        end
+    end
+
+    assign wr_addr = wr_bin[ADDR_WIDTH-1:0];
+
+endmodule
+
+
+// ==========================================================================
+// Module 4: Read Pointer & Empty Flag Generation
+// ==========================================================================
+module async_fifo_rd_ptr #(
+    parameter ADDR_WIDTH = 4
+)(
+    input  logic                    rd_clk,
+    input  logic                    rd_rst_n,
+    input  logic                    rd_en,
+    input  logic [ADDR_WIDTH:0]     wr_gray_sync,
+    output logic [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0]   rd_addr,
+    output logic [ADDR_WIDTH:0]     rd_gray_ptr,
+    output logic                    rd_empty
+);
+
+    // Binary pointer: ADDR_WIDTH+1 bits
+    logic [ADDR_WIDTH:0] rd_bin;
+    logic [ADDR_WIDTH:0] rd_bin_next;
+    logic [ADDR_WIDTH:0] rd_gray_next;
+    logic                rd_empty_next;
+
+    assign rd_bin_next = rd_bin + (rd_en & ~rd_empty);
+    assign rd_gray_next = rd_bin_next ^ (rd_bin_next >> 1);
+    assign rd_empty_next = (rd_gray_next == wr_gray_sync);
+
+    always_ff @(posedge rd_clk or negedge rd_rst_n) begin
+        if (!rd_rst_n) begin
+            rd_bin <= '0;
+            rd_gray_ptr <= '0;
+            rd_empty <= 1'b1;
+        end else begin
+            rd_bin <= rd_bin_next;
+            rd_gray_ptr <= rd_gray_next;
+            rd_empty <= rd_empty_next;
+        end
+    end
+
+    assign rd_addr = rd_bin[ADDR_WIDTH-1:0];
+
+endmodule
+
+
+// ==========================================================================
+// Top-Level Module: Asynchronous FIFO
+// ==========================================================================
+module async_fifo #(
+    parameter DATA_WIDTH = 8,
+    parameter ADDR_WIDTH = 4
+)(
+    // Write domain
+    input  logic                  wr_clk,
+    input  logic                  wr_rst_n,
+    input  logic                  wr_en,
+    input  logic [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] wr_data,
+    output logic                  wr_full,
+    // Read domain
+    input  logic                  rd_clk,
+    input  logic                  rd_rst_n,
+    input  logic                  rd_en,
+    output logic [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] rd_data,
+    output logic                  rd_empty
+);
+
+    logic [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] wr_addr;
+    logic [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] rd_addr;
+    logic [ADDR_WIDTH:0]   wr_gray_ptr;
+    logic [ADDR_WIDTH:0]   rd_gray_ptr;
+    logic [ADDR_WIDTH:0]   wr_gray_sync;
+    logic [ADDR_WIDTH:0]   rd_gray_sync;
+
+    logic wr_en_gated;
+
+    assign wr_en_gated = wr_en & ~wr_full;
+
+    // RAM
+    async_fifo_mem #(
+        .DATA_WIDTH(DATA_WIDTH),
+        .ADDR_WIDTH(ADDR_WIDTH)
+    ) u_mem (
+        .wr_clk(wr_clk),
+        .wr_en(wr_en_gated),
+        .wr_addr(wr_addr),
+        .wr_data(wr_data),
+        .rd_addr(rd_addr),
+        .rd_data(rd_data)
+    );
+
+    // Write pointer & full logic
+    async_fifo_wr_ptr #(
+        .ADDR_WIDTH(ADDR_WIDTH)
+    ) u_wr_ptr (
+        .wr_clk(wr_clk),
+        .wr_rst_n(wr_rst_n),
+        .wr_en(wr_en),
+        .rd_gray_sync(rd_gray_sync),
+        .wr_addr(wr_addr),
+        .wr_gray_ptr(wr_gray_ptr),
+        .wr_full(wr_full)
+    );
+
+    // Read pointer & empty logic
+    async_fifo_rd_ptr #(
+        .ADDR_WIDTH(ADDR_WIDTH)
+    ) u_rd_ptr (
+        .rd_clk(rd_clk),
+        .rd_rst_n(rd_rst_n),
+        .rd_en(rd_en),
+        .wr_gray_sync(wr_gray_sync),
+        .rd_addr(rd_addr),
+        .rd_gray_ptr(rd_gray_ptr),
+        .rd_empty(rd_empty)
+    );
+
+    // Synchronizers
+    sync_2ff #(
+        .WIDTH(ADDR_WIDTH + 1)
+    ) u_sync_wr2rd (
+        .clk(rd_clk),
+        .rst_n(rd_rst_n),
+        .d_in(wr_gray_ptr),
+        .q_out(wr_gray_sync)
+    );
+
+    sync_2ff #(
+        .WIDTH(ADDR_WIDTH + 1)
+    ) u_sync_rd2wr (
+        .clk(wr_clk),
+        .rst_n(wr_rst_n),
+        .d_in(rd_gray_ptr),
+        .q_out(rd_gray_sync)
+    );
+
+endmodule
